```plato

// The Darboux frame of a curve lying on a surface: curve tangent, surface normal,
// and tangent normal (surface normal cross tangent). Normal and geodesic
// curvatures are in reciprocal world units; geodesic torsion likewise.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Darboux_frame)
type DarbouxFrame3D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Tangent: Direction3D;
    SurfaceNormal: Direction3D;
    TangentNormal: Direction3D;
    NormalCurvature: Number;
    GeodesicCurvature: Number;
    GeodesicTorsion: Number;
}
```
